title: Poe in Control
description: Finn, Han Solo and Chewbacca apprehended the First Order's Stormtrooper commander Captain Phasma at gunpoint, forcing her to deactivate Starkiller Base's protective shields. Having no choice, she complied, enabling Poe Dameron's X-wings to pummel the First Order installation. Even so, Starkiller's superweapon was charging itself up by siphoning power from a nearby sun. Once fully charged, it could fire on and instantly annihilate the Resistance base on D'Qar.
